item.coloph: ces snyan gnas seng ge gnam rdzong rdo rje yongs rdzong zung gi dkar chag me tog phreng ba 'di ni/ snyigs ma'i kho bo kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can gyis ri lo bla ma dbang ldan gyis (gyi) gzim chung du bkod pa/ lcags bya zla ba bzhi ba'i nya sngo ba'i dus su grub chen gyi tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i thun skabs su bris pa dge legs 'phel rgyas shog/
